What We Do

Roofing services, all under one umbrella

From a first survey to a finished roof, one team looks after the whole job — no chasing different trades, no gaps in responsibility.

Services shown are the proposed range for Next Gen Roof Surveys Limited, to be confirmed with the company before launch.

Roof Surveys & Inspections

A thorough inspection of your roof’s condition, carried out safely and recorded in detail — so decisions are based on evidence, not guesswork.

Enquire about this service

Roof Repairs & Maintenance

Leaks, slipped tiles, damaged flashing and general wear — repaired properly, with planned maintenance to help prevent small issues becoming costly ones.

Enquire about this service

New Roof Installations

Complete new roofs and full re-roofs, installed with care from the first batten to the final ridge tile — for homes, extensions and commercial buildings.

Enquire about this service

Flat Roofing

Surveys, repairs and installations for flat and low-slope roofs — including felt, membrane and liquid-applied systems for homes and commercial premises.

Enquire about this service

Pitched Roofing

Slate, tile and traditional pitched roofing — from individual repairs to complete re-roofs, finished to suit the character of your property.

Enquire about this service

Commercial Roofing

Roofing surveys, maintenance and works for warehouses, offices, schools and managed buildings — planned around your operations to keep disruption low.

Enquire about this service

Roof Condition Reports

Clear, written condition reports with photographs and prioritised recommendations — useful for buyers, sellers, landlords and building managers.

Enquire about this service

Drone Roof Surveys

High-resolution aerial imagery of hard-to-reach roofs — a safe, efficient way to inspect large, tall or fragile roofs without scaffolding, where offered.

Why Choose Us

Why choose Next Gen Roof Surveys?

A straightforward promise: professional work, honest advice and one team responsible for your roof from the first look to the finished job.

Professional service

A tidy, courteous and safety-conscious approach on every job, whether it is a single repair or a full commercial programme.

Clear communication

Plain-English explanations, honest advice and no pressure — you always know what we found, what it means and what your options are.

Detailed assessments

Thorough surveys with photographic evidence, so recommendations are based on the actual condition of your roof — not assumptions.

Tailored solutions

Every roof is different. We recommend the right approach for your building, your priorities and your budget — repair where repair is right, replace only where needed.

Residential & commercial

Homeowners, landlords, facilities managers and commercial clients — one team covers properties of every size and roof type.

One point of responsibility

Surveys, reports and roofing works under one umbrella — one conversation, one team accountable for the outcome.

Our Process

A simple, clear journey

Four straightforward steps from your first enquiry to a clear way forward for your roof.

01

Tell Us About Your Roof

Get in touch with a few details about your property and what you have noticed — a leak, damage, or simply a roof you would like checked.

02

Arrange an Assessment

We agree a convenient time to inspect your roof — in person, by drone, or a combination of both, depending on the building.

03

Receive Your Recommendations

You receive clear findings with photographs and prioritised recommendations, explained in plain English — urgent items first.

04

Discuss the Next Steps

We talk through your options and agree the right way forward — with no obligation and no pressure to proceed.
